args.sql: SELECT DISTINCT LOWER(TRIM(vehicleinventory->>'Newest_Year')) as ny FROM transportation_assets LIMIT 30;
SELECT DISTINCT LOWER(TRIM(vehicleinventory->>'Newest_Year')) as ny FROM transportation_assets ORDER BY ny LIMIT 50;

SELECT h.housenum
FROM households h
JOIN amenities a ON a.houseid = h.housenum
JOIN properties p ON p.houselink = h.housenum
JOIN transportation_assets t ON t.housetag = h.housenum
WHERE 
  -- Many vehicles / Highly mobile: more than 2 total vehicles
  ((t.vehicleinventory->'vehicle_counts'->>'Auto_Count')::int +
   (t.vehicleinventory->'vehicle_counts'->>'Bike_Count')::int +
   (t.vehicleinventory->'vehicle_counts'->>'Motor_Count')::int) > 2
  -- Recent vehicle year range
  AND LOWER(TRIM(t.vehicleinventory->>'Newest_Year')) IN (
    '2005 to 2009', '2005-2009', '05-09', '2005\tto 2009', '2005  to 2009',
    '2010 to 2013', '2010-2013', '10-13', '2010\tto 2013', '2010  to 2013',
    '2014 or newer', '2014+\n', '2014+', '2014 and newer', '2014\tor newer', '2014  or newer', 'after 2014'
  )
  -- Updated residence: dwelling type is brickwork house or apartment
  AND LOWER(TRIM(p.dwelling_specs->>'Dwelling_Class')) IN ('brickwork house', 'apartment')
  -- Updated residence: active cable status
  AND LOWER(TRIM(a.cablestatus)) IN ('avail', 'available', 'yes');

-- Check one of the returned homes to verify
SELECT h.housenum, 
  t.vehicleinventory->>'Newest_Year' as newest_year,
  (t.vehicleinventory->'vehicle_counts'->>'Auto_Count')::int +
  (t.vehicleinventory->'vehicle_counts'->>'Bike_Count')::int +
  (t.vehicleinventory->'vehicle_counts'->>'Motor_Count')::int as total_vehicles,
  p.dwelling_specs->>'Dwelling_Class' as dw_class,
  a.cablestatus as cable_status
FROM households h
JOIN amenities a ON a.houseid = h.housenum
JOIN properties p ON p.houselink = h.housenum
JOIN transportation_assets t ON t.housetag = h.housenum
WHERE h.housenum = 4;
